page_title: STR 1-3 NIC | Strasbourg v Nice 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+2' Morgan Sanson (Nice) picks up a yellow card.
90+2' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) fires in a shot from the edge of the box which deflects off one of the defending players and hits the left post!
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
85' Melvin Bard (Nice) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
84' 1 - 3 Goal Morgan Sanson (Nice)! Morgan Sanson (Nice) was put through by Romain Perraud and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Romain Perraud (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Jeremie Boga can be given a rest.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Evann Guessand as he is replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
80' The opposition can't get near Jeremie Boga (Nice), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just over the bar at the last second.
78' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Emanuel Emegha and he is replaced by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
78' Dilane Bakwa comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg).
74' The ball is cleared after Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
70' That will be all from Mohamed-Ali Cho who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Terem Moffi (Nice).
69' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) replacing Ibrahima Sissoko.
69' A substitution has been made. Thomas Delaine is replaced by Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg).
64' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
63' Thomas Leonard shows the yellow card to Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) for a heavy challenge.
62' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Antoine Mendy (Nice) replaces Youssouf Ndayishimiye.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hicham Boudaoui departs the field of play to be replaced by Morgan Sanson (Nice).
61' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
58' A player from Nice takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
52' 1 - 2 Gooal! Jeremie Boga takes over corner duties. Dante (Nice) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 1:2.
52' Nice force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
49' Half-chance! Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) plays a pass into the box, but Alaa Bellaarouch reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45+1' Dante (Nice) tackles a bit over-zealously and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul. Strasbourg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Evann Guessand (Nice) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Alaa Bellaarouch to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
43' Evann Guessand (Nice) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
42' Thomas Leonard blows the whistle, Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Nice.
40' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
35' Evann Guessand (Nice) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
34' It's like he was asking for a caution. Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) receives a yellow card.
33' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Pablo Rosario (Nice) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Nice are ruled offside.
28' Nice couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Alaa Bellaarouch (Strasbourg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
28' A player from Strasbourg brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Nice will take a free kick.
26' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
18' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by Marcin Bulka.
17' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
15' Superb touch by Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save!
12' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' A cross from a corner kick by Nice is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
10' Evann Guessand (Nice) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
8' Strasbourg take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
7' Thomas Leonard has a clear sight and sees a foul from Khephren Thuram (Nice). A free kick has been awarded to Strasbourg.
5' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.

4' OFF THE POST! Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) found himself some space to take a shot from just outside the box. His effort was headed to the right side of the goal, but Marcin Bulka came up with a save and tipped the ball onto the post.
3' Strasbourg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Thomas Leonard was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
